fileManagerBlock.title: File Manager 1
fileManagerBlock.description: A token-native, storage-agnostic workspace for browsing and managing files in icon, list, and Finder-style column views.
fileManagerBlock.guidanceBody: Keep file records and storage mutations in your product, then connect createFolder, rename, move, remove, and download through actions. For paged or lazy APIs, use controlled currentFolderId with breadcrumbItems, dataMode=server, and onRequestData; it receives the active folder, query, sort, and AbortSignal. Merge each response into your cache and handle rejected requests with onError.
